item.description:
I am an assistant professor in the School of Computer and Communication Sciences at EPFL. I lead the EPFL NLP group where we conduct research on natural language processing (NLP) systems that can model, represent, and reason about human and world knowledge.

Previously, I was a postdoctoral researcher at Stanford University in the SNAP and NLP groups working with Jure Leskovec and Chris Manning. I completed my PhD in NLP at the University of Washington, where I worked with Yejin Choi.

I will be taking on new PhD students next year.

If you are interesting in joining EPFL NLP, please read the Join Us page.
